template.title: The Tree Hollow Mailbox
template.summary: A child leaves a drawing in a hollow tree, receives a mysterious reply, and feels a secret friendship grow.

sentences.text_with_blanks: On a sunny morning, [[slot_child]] walked to the edge of the park and found a big [[slot_tree_type]] tree with a hollow trunk.
Inside the hollow, [[slot_child]] left a tiny drawing of a smiling sun and a note that said, 'Hello, friend!'
He closed his eyes and imagined a friendly [[slot_imagined_friend]] listening from the shadows.
The next day, [[slot_child]] returned, hoping the tree would whisper back.
When he peered into the dark hole, a shiny white envelope glowed in the gloom.
On the envelope was a tiny feather and a short poem that read, 'Your kindness brightens my day!'
Feeling warm inside, [[slot_child]] tucked the feather back into the hollow and drew a tiny star on the note.
He whispered, 'Thank you, mysterious friend,' and felt a gentle breeze that seemed to say, 'I am here!'
From that day on, [[slot_child]] looked at the [[slot_tree_type]] tree with new wonder, knowing a secret friend was watching.
Every time he walked past, the tree seemed to smile, and [[slot_child]] felt happy and connected to someone special.
